cases: TC-1 · AC-2 REQ-3 REQ-4 before 14:00 on a business day ships that day; 1st of the month; transitDays 1 · promiseDelivery(bookedAt=2026-07-01T09:00, transitDays=1, holidays=[]) → shipDate=2026-07-01, deliveryDate=2026-07-02

TC-2 · AC-3 cutoff exactly 14:00 is not before 14:00, so ship the next business day · promiseDelivery(bookedAt=2026-07-01T14:00, transitDays=1, holidays=[]) → shipDate=2026-07-02, deliveryDate=2026-07-03
TC-3 · cutoff one minute below 14:00 still ships that business day · promiseDelivery(bookedAt=2026-07-01T13:59, transitDays=2, holidays=[]) → shipDate=2026-07-01, deliveryDate=2026-07-03

TC-4 · cutoff one minute above 14:00 ships the next business day; delivery count skips the weekend · promiseDelivery(bookedAt=2026-07-01T14:01, transitDays=2, holidays=[]) → shipDate=2026-07-02, deliveryDate=2026-07-06 (Fri 2026-07-03=1, Mon 2026-07-06=2)

TC-5 · AC-1 single holiday: Friday after 14:00 skips Sat, Sun and Mon 2026-07-06 · promiseDelivery(bookedAt=2026-07-03T15:00, transitDays=2, holidays=["2026-07-06"]) → shipDate=2026-07-07, deliveryDate=2026-07-09 (Wed 2026-07-08=1, Thu 2026-07-09=2)

TC-6 · empty holiday list: same Friday booking ships Monday, not Tuesday · promiseDelivery(bookedAt=2026-07-03T15:00, transitDays=2, holidays=[]) → shipDate=2026-07-06, deliveryDate=2026-07-08 (Tue 2026-07-07=1, Wed 2026-07-08=2)

TC-7 · booking on a holiday ships the next business day; that holiday is first in the list · promiseDelivery(bookedAt=2026-07-06T09:00, transitDays=2, holidays=["2026-07-06","2026-01-01","2026-12-25"]) → shipDate=2026-07-07, deliveryDate=2026-07-09

TC-8 · the holiday the rule uses is in the middle of the list · promiseDelivery(bookedAt=2026-07-06T09:00, transitDays=2, holidays=["2026-01-01","2026-07-06","2026-12-25"]) → shipDate=2026-07-07, deliveryDate=2026-07-09

TC-9 · the holiday the rule uses is last in the list · promiseDelivery(bookedAt=2026-07-06T09:00, transitDays=2, holidays=["2026-01-01","2026-12-25","2026-07-06"]) → shipDate=2026-07-07, deliveryDate=2026-07-09

TC-10 · Sunday is not a ship day; transitDays 0, the smallest allowed value, so deliveryDate equals shipDate · promiseDelivery(bookedAt=2026-07-05T08:00, transitDays=0, holidays=[]) → shipDate=2026-07-06, deliveryDate=2026-07-06

TC-11 · leap day is a business ship day; a holiday on the 1st is not counted in transit · promiseDelivery(bookedAt=2024-02-28T15:00, transitDays=2, holidays=["2024-03-01"]) → shipDate=2024-02-29, deliveryDate=2024-03-05 (Wed 15:00 ships Thu 2024-02-29; skip Fri 2024-03-01, Mon 2024-03-04=1, Tue 2024-03-05=2)

TC-12 · 31 December after cutoff ships 1 January; forms 2 and 2.0 are the same whole number · promiseDelivery(bookedAt=2026-12-31T15:00, transitDays=2, holidays=[]) and promiseDelivery(bookedAt=2026-12-31T15:00, transitDays=2.0, holidays=[]) → shipDate=2027-01-01, deliveryDate=2027-01-05 (Thu 15:00 ships Fri 2027-01-01; Mon 2027-01-04=1, Tue 2027-01-05=2)

TC-13 · Saturday before 14:00 ships the next business day; 5 transit days cross the following weekend · promiseDelivery(bookedAt=2026-07-04T09:00, transitDays=5, holidays=[]) → shipDate=2026-07-06, deliveryDate=2026-07-13 (Tue 2026-07-07=1, Wed 2026-07-08=2, Thu 2026-07-09=3, Fri 2026-07-10=4, Mon 2026-07-13=5)
TC-14 · transitDays one step below the minimum 0 · promiseDelivery(bookedAt=2026-07-01T11:00, transitDays=-1, holidays=[]) → Error "invalid transitDays"
TC-15 · transitDays not a whole number, including the halfway value 2.5 · promiseDelivery(bookedAt=2026-07-01T11:30, transitDays=2.5, holidays=[]) → Error "invalid transitDays"
TC-16 · input field other than bookedAt, transitDays or holidays · promiseDelivery(bookedAt=2026-07-01T09:00, transitDays=1, holidays=[], customerId="C9") → Error "unknown field: customerId"
